goal: Speed up compact block relay by prefilling transactions that were missing from local mempools
Avoid high-latency round-trips during block reconstruction to reduce stale block risk
agreement: Strong support across the board with no open objections
Verified with node telemetry confirming prefill effectiveness (m4ycon)
Verified across v1 and v2 compact block test suites (s00ly)
Supported for its simplicity and backwards compatibility (josibake)
Concept approval without stated reasons (edilmedeiros, murchandamus, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because roughly 43% of compact block reconstructions currently need an extra round-trip
Accelerates block propagation network-wide and lowers stale block risk without unbounded TCP bloat
